prompts.idle: Edit target: the supplied owner-approved dimensional Phil character. Preserve his exact recognizable identity, stylized 3D quality and costume: friendly adult human tech-hippie, long chestnut hair and full beard/moustache, round wire glasses, orange/bronze headphones, orange-blue-purple tie-dye shirt, brown fringed vest with purple patch/flower, gold peace pendant, patched flared jeans, brown sandals and gray tablet. PRIMARY REQUIRED CHANGE: make Phil face DIRECTLY FRONT toward the viewer, both face and upper body square to camera. Level head, horizontal eye line, nose centered between equally visible eyes, both glasses lenses same apparent size, both headphone cups equally visible, balanced front-facing shoulders and torso. No three-quarter angle, no turned head, no leaning or head tilt in this base pose. Warm engaged closed-mouth smile and direct eye contact. Tablet tucked in his arm on viewer-left, free viewer-right hand open in a welcoming palm-up gesture. Comfortable front-facing stance, both feet on same ground line, entire hair and sandals visible with clear margins. Single full-body portrait, consistent source scale with reference, high detail 1024x1536 or higher. Genuinely transparent background and gaps with alpha zero, no colored glow, no haze, no floor or shadow plane, no text, no extra subjects or panels.
